entries.en: to become sad, to grieve; sad, sorrowful (triste)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑指手脚麻木；汉字栏作「肚」（腹部）
entries.en: 〔text damaged, sense uncertain〕 prob. numb in hands and feet; the Chinese column reads 肚 'belly'
entries.notes: M、R 两栏仅残存 Bŷ，H「肚」与 L entrugido（疑即 entumido）不合，义无法定夺。

entries.en: to send, to post; to entrust for delivery
to employ, to make use of; to send (a person) on service
entries.notes: L 仅作 enviar，H 取「用」之任用义，M 栏夹 embaxada 残片，据以判为遣使用人。

entries.en: to send as a gift; to present, to offer
to send in another's place; to hand over, to deliver
entries.notes: L 栏 enpayar 疑为讹写；H「付」与 M 栏 cau hû（交付）互证。

entries.en: to dispatch, to send off (on an errand)
entries.notes: L 之 en baxada 义未详，余三栏一致作「差使」，故降为中置信。

entries.en: to send an embassy/envoy; to employ (a person)

entries.zh: 捎信问候，寄讯探问（遣人问安）
entries.en: to send a message of inquiry or greeting (a visit message)
entries.notes: H 第二字有「探/採」之疑，然于义无碍，四栏读音一致。

entries.zh: 向总督呈送行状（长篇禀报、行述）
entries.en: to send the Viceroy a long report / account of conduct (行狀)
entries.notes: L 句尾 largamon de 残缺，M 栏 guia/heng 亦存疑，义据「行狀」与 al Virrey 推定。

entries.en: to send troops to battle; to dispatch soldiers
to dispatch, to send off; to dismiss
to send a card or invitation, to deliver a billet
entries.notes: L 栏 villereᵖ 为缩写且句尾残缺，H「下帖」与 M 栏读音足证其义。

entries.zh: 猜灯谜（张灯悬谜、供人猜射之戏）
entries.en: lantern riddles (riddles hung up at festival time to be guessed)
entries.notes: H 第三字有「猜/清」之疑，L 句残而 Pascua 可辨，义定为节期灯谜。

entries.zh: 牙龈（齿龈）〔原件有涂改，字形存疑〕
entries.en: gums of the mouth; text altered, character uncertain
entries.notes: L 作 encías（牙龈），然 H「齒踞」与 M qûy câ 均不合常式，疑有讹写，故低置信。

entries.en: gums of the mouth; 齒仁 is a popular form of 齒齦
entries.notes: H 第二字有「仁/齦」之疑，二者义同，皆指牙龈。
